certification: Not a full semantic certification: source helper graphs, producer schemas, selected directed/reused assertions and remaining branches are recorded. No live cloud validation, content reads or offensive workflows.
source_tracking_note: Current complete file hashes are captured, including concurrent root-owned changes. Original input hashes are preserved per row. Static closure traversal follows wrappers, function defaults and exact-ID evaluator dictionaries; dynamically imported successors are explicit references.
runtime_files_owned_in_expanded_dispatch: peaso/collectors/gcp.py (Workspace methods and tightly necessary group-customer selection only)
peaso/checks/batch_remaining_gcp.py (Workspace callbacks/helper and exact Storage callback/dependencies only)

bucket.native_representation_review: buckets.list projection=full; bucket iamPolicy hydration has separate field coverage. ACL inventories are hashed metadata; materialize projects only complete parent/page/version evidence. Effective IAM rejects unknown roles, conditions and folder coverage.

sql_instance.native_representation_review: instances.list returns settings/databaseFlags name/value, ipAddresses, engine and instanceType; users.list is independently enveloped and projected to usersList. A denied user read does not hide unrelated instance settings.

sql_user.native_representation_review: users.list raw name/host/type/passwordPolicy is preserved; parent project/instance fields are validated and username/instanceId plus URL-qualified name are projected. Optional raw host is normalized to empty, so MySQL host policy can remain UNKNOWN.

bigquery_dataset.native_representation_review: datasets.list is partial; datasets.get datasetView=FULL/accessPolicyVersion=3 merges native ACL/defaultEncryptionConfiguration and marks full only after collected details. Denied details preserve partial representation and field coverage.

bigquery_table.native_representation_review: tables.list rows are hydrated by tables.get; tableDetails coverage and schema_full provenance are explicit. Fields include type, encryptionConfiguration and recursive schema.fields[].policyTags.names.

kms_key.native_representation_review: locations -> keyRings -> cryptoKeys.list produces full unmasked keys, purpose/primary/rotationPeriod/nextRotationTime/destroyScheduledDuration and local policy; cryptoKeyVersions is separately enumerated. Effective-use producer resolves roles and read-only Troubleshooter results; groups/conditions/public principals unresolved.

iam_policy.native_representation_review: Direct CRM getIamPolicy full representation is distinct from Cloud Asset IAM search views. Ancestry union and field/source request coverage are materialized; audit configs, bindings, members and conditions remain native declarations.

service_account.native_representation_review: serviceAccounts.list plus getIamPolicy and optional Policy Analyzer activity produces email/name/projectId/disabled, iamPolicy and _activity. An account absent from observed activity is unknown rather than proven unused.

service_account_key.native_representation_review: keys.list per complete service account preserves keyType/validAfterTime/disabled, drops key material, adds serviceAccount parent and optional activity. Parent inventory and activity read coverage are distinct.

secret.native_representation_review: secrets.list metadata and secret getIamPolicy produce rotation.nextRotationTime and iamPolicy. rotationPeriod is input-only and may not be present on reads; its absence must not create a rotation PASS.

workspace_user.native_representation_review: users.list full/admin_view with narrow field mask explicitly selects enrollment, enforcement, recovery email and user status. Per-field projection authority is retained without globally marking the User full. Independent direct CRM project/parent/organization reads bind customerId; read failures remain UNKNOWN.

workspace_role_assignment.native_representation_review: Directory roles and roleassignments are narrowed selected fields; requested customer and native CRM/Directory joins are explicit. Separation dispatches to the pinned sw52_native_successor helper; unsupported indirect/conditional administrative grants remain UNKNOWN.

workload_identity_provider.native_representation_review: Pools inventory gates provider list; native state/disabled/oidc.issuerUri/attributeCondition are declaration facts. Attribute condition presence does not prove tenant restriction correctness.

storage_hmac_key.native_representation_review: projects/hmacKeys.list metadata produces accessId/state/serviceAccountEmail/timeCreated; no secret key retrieval. Age is measured at captured time; inactive/deleted keys are not applicable.

bucket_notification.native_representation_review: Per-bucket notificationConfigs list projects bucket and bucketProject, preserves topic/event filters and omits custom attributes. Numeric project scopes remain unresolved for topic project-ID comparison.

alloydb_instance.native_representation_review: Native AlloyDB instances expose databaseFlags as a string map; this is not Cloud SQL databaseFlags list syntax. Locations/clusters/instance parent inventory and error coverage bound observation.

alloydb_cluster.native_representation_review: Clusters list supplies encryptionInfo.encryptionType; key material is not collected. Unknown enum/missing fields remain UNKNOWN.

logging_bucket.native_representation_review: Logging bucket locations list produces retentionDays/locked/lifecycle metadata, distinct from Cloud Storage Bucket retentionPolicy. Fixed minimum metadata is configuration evidence, not retention adequacy for every data class.
